title: Oven Charred Norwegian Udon Noodles
description: A low-carb, hangover-cure Norwegian dish featuring charred udon noodles and ssam-wrap, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the udon noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Season the norwegian salmon fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon fillets for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the salmon fillets to a terracotta dish and bake in the oven for 8 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Brush the soy sauce mixture onto the udon noodles and spread them out in the terracotta dish with the salmon fillets.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 4 minutes, or until the noodles are slightly charred.
Serve the oven charred norwegian udon noodles in the terracotta dish with ssam wrap on the side.
Allow each guest to assemble their own ssam wrap with the charred noodles and salmon.
